name: 3D Protein Structure Agent
description: Resolves a gene or accession to a canonical protein identity, finds the best available 3D structure for it, maps functional annotations onto that structure, and returns a viewer-ready molecular scene. Covers the 3D structure, shape and folding of a protein; experimental structures and predicted models; protein domains, binding sites and residue-level mapping of a mutation or position; and rendered molecular views. Needs the species, plus a gene symbol or UniProt accession, before it can start.
